title: Introduce RAG Offline Debug Sandbox quickstart for low-connectivity environments
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Customers building RAG-enabled products in field-deployed or intermittent-network contexts asked for a reference that demonstrates how to run Redwood inference and a retrieval layer when connectivity is poor or unavailable. This quickstart provides an opinionated, small-footprint sandbox that: 1) shows offline index building and a compact on-disk vector store, 2) demonstrates a local wasm retriever and optional local LLM runtime shim, 3) includes a step-through debugging UI for replaying sessions and inspecting prefix/KV cache behavior, and 4) instruments a telemetry shim that buffers and ships when the network reconnects.

Summary of changes: Added a new quickstart at quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox with a guided README, sample dataset, a docker-compose + Makefile to bootstrap the sandbox, a tiny wasm retriever (demo code) and a local cache adapter, sample prompts and recorded session replays for the debug UI, and a telemetry shim that simulates backpressure and buffered uploads. The quickstart targets engineers who want a reproducible pattern to: prebuild compact indexes at CI or on-device, run retrieval+LLM in constrained environments, and record traces for postmortem analysis.

Why this is different: Existing quickstarts assume stable network and hosted telemetry. This project shows pragmatic knobs for narrowband (e.g., satellite, factory-floor) use: low-memory quantized embeddings, aggressive prefix/KV cache reuse, opportunistic background sync, and a developer-friendly replay tool for diagnosing mismatches between cached and live model outputs.

Files added: quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox/README.md, quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox/docker-compose.yml, quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox/Makefile, quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox/sample-data/mini-kb.jsonl, quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox/retriever/README-wasm.md, quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox/retriever/wasm-retriever-demo.ts, quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox/debug-ui/README.md, quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox/debug-ui/session-replayer.jsonl, quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox/telemetry/offline-shim.js.

Usage (short): git clone && cd quickstarts/offline-rag-sandbox && make bootstrap && docker-compose up --build. The README contains step-by-step commands to index the sample-data, run the wasm retriever in dev mode, run the Redwood API shim configured to prefer local cache, and then drive the debug UI to replay a recorded session and inspect token-level cache reuse and model fallback logic.

Testing and CI: Added a lightweight smoke script run by CI that runs the indexer, starts the retriever container, and asserts that the sample query returns the expected top-k documents within a 500ms retrieval target on a small VM. CI pipeline shows build/lint/unit-smoke passing; synthetic e2e occasionally flaked on cold-cache startup which is mitigated by a retry in the bootstrap script.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add quickstart files and sample dataset
- [x] Add Makefile and docker-compose for reproducible local runs
- [x] Add debug UI session replay data and documentation
- [x] Add telemetry shim example and instructions for buffered uploads
- [x] Smoke CI test added
- [x] Docs reviewed by platform and runtime teams

Migration and rollout notes: This is additive, no platform changes required. The example references the Redwood-hosted API by default but includes instructions to run entirely offline using a local LLM shim (experimental). Recommend shipping to the docs site under Quickstarts > Offline & Edge RAG (docs staging), and announce to SDKs and solutions channels to collect early feedback.

Related: ENG-1412 (offline vector stores), PM-89 (customer ask from field trials).
commit_summary: Initial author commit with README and bootstrap scripts; add wasm retriever demo; add debug UI replay data; CI smoke test; follow-up commit fixes Makefile path and adds retry for flakey cold-indexing; documentation tweaks after reviewer feedback.
conversation: Arjun Patel (reviewer): Nice focused quickstart — can we keep the wasm demo in TS only (no Rust build) for simplicity? Also suggest adding a note about security considerations for local telemetry buffering.
Maya Chen (author): Addressed — removed Rust variant, added security paragraph and explicit encryption-at-rest recommendation for the buffer file. Fixed in second commit.

Sofia Martinez (reviewer): CI smoke failure reproduced locally (cold-index race). Suggest adding an explicit wait/retry in bootstrap and marking the e2e as flaky in CI with rerun. Also asked for clearer guidance on when to use local LLM shim vs hosted API.
Maya Chen (author): Added retry loop to Makefile and updated README with decision criteria for local shim vs hosted API. Updated CI to allow one rerun on flaky e2e.
release_notes: Add Offline RAG Debug Sandbox quickstart: reproducible local indexer, wasm retriever demo, session replayer UI, and telemetry buffering/shipping shim. Useful for low-connectivity and edge deployments.
notes_for_release_manager: Docs entry will go to staging docs site under Quickstarts > Offline & Edge RAG. No platform migration required. Recommend adding a short blog post with field notes from ENG-1412 after initial feedback.
risk_assessment: low (examples and docs only); telemetry shim is an example pattern, not production library. Ensure encryption guidance is followed if users persist buffers to disk.
